Certificate of Lawfulness (Existing) is sought for the property located at 9 Banchory Road, SE3 8SL has been used as use class C4, House in Multiple Occupation (HMO). The submitted plans identify a property comprising four bedrooms together with shared kitchen, bathroom and living accommodation. The site and property are shown on the submitted drawings in support of the application. To demonstrate the long-established use of the property for letting and occupation by multiple unrelated occupants, a selection of bank account records, council tax records, residency data as shown on the electoral role and a statutory declaration by Kimberely Frances Lewis dated 4th September 2026 and a detailed schedule of occupants. Collectively, this information demonstrates the continuous occupation of the property by multiple unrelated individuals over a period significantly exceeding the relevant immunity period.
